days.title: Villages and Museums of the Nature Park
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Scharten
stops.detail: Orchards, rows of trees and fruit plantations shape the gently rolling cultural landscape in the Obst-Hügel-Land Nature Park, in the municipalities of Scharten and St. Marienkirchen an der Polsenz.

stops.name: St. Marienkirchen an der Polsenz
stops.detail: Beautiful circular trail in St. Marienkirchen an der Polsenz through the orchard landscape in the Obst-Hügel-Land Nature Park.

stops.name: Mostmuseum St. Marienkirchen an der Polsenz
stops.detail: Attractions: especially the Cider Museum St. Marienkirchen an der Polsenz.

stops.name: Schartner Höhe

stops.name: Jausenstation Beißl
stops.detail: after approx. 100 m turn right over the bridge towards Herrnholz – Jausenstation Beißl – approx. 100 m to the Herrnholzer municipal road.

stops.name: Obsthof Pachinger/Bischläger
stops.detail: left towards Obsthof Pachinger/Bischläger (sign) – turn left directly at the house – towards Kronberg to Güterweg Kronberg – continue right along the freight road to Schartner Höhe.
